shots.name: iphone-after-01-expense-delete.jpg
shots.note: Delete expense: names the entry, amount, date and receipt count, says it is deleted (not reversed) and cannot be undone; destructive Delete expense, Keep expense

shots.name: iphone-after-02-trip-cancel.jpg
shots.note: Cancel trip: records stay, trip marked cancelled, can be undone; Keep trip or Cancel trip

shots.name: ipad-after-01-expense-delete.jpg

shots.name: ipad-after-02-trip-cancel.jpg

shots.name: ipad-after-03-period-close.jpg
shots.note: Close period: names the period, lists what is locked and that only the Audit operation (Reopen with a reason) can reopen it; Close period stays off until the period is typed

shots.name: ipad-after-04-period-close-typed.jpg
shots.note: Close period: the typed period matches, so Close period is enabled (nothing is sent until it is pressed)

shots.name: ipad-after-05-freeze-fy.jpg
shots.note: Freeze FY: names the year and its dates, lists what is locked and who can reopen it; type the FY label to enable Freeze

shots.name: ipad-after-06-period-reopen.jpg
shots.note: Reopen a closed period: names the period; the reason is required and kept permanently

shots.name: ipad-after-07-period-reopen-error.jpg
shots.note: Reopen: an empty reason is explained inline; nothing sent
